description: This source file defines the CLIInstallPrompter class, which manages prompting the user to install a CLI component within a macOS application. It handles user interactions via NSAlert, checks application state conditions, initiates CLI installation, and communicates with other application components such as settings and notification center.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for prompting users to install the CLI, checking application state conditions, managing the installation process asynchronously, and opening settings.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: A private actor class used to asynchronously set and get status messages during the CLI installation process.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks if conditions are suitable for prompting the user and displays an alert with options to install the CLI, update settings, or dismiss.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines whether the user should be prompted based on app state, previous prompts, and version checks.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Async method to handle the CLI installation, updating status messages, and displaying completion alerts.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the app settings window and posts a notification to switch to the relevant settings tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current app version from the bundle's info dictionary.
